newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti board holds meeting in Milan.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti board holds meeting in Milan.

text.p: The board of Italian information technology group Olivetti held an unscheduled meeting in Milan at 1700 local time (1500 GMT) on Tuesday after rumours of continuing problems hammered its share price on the bourse.
Sources close to the company said the meeting "could be long", but they gave no details of the agenda.

Olivetti shares fell five percent on the day to 726 lire per share after dropping three percent on Monday amid persistent rumours of greater than expected losses for the first half of 1996 and conflict among top management.
Olivetti itself made no comment on the rumours.
